# L0 Wiki

I use this wiki as the readable entry point for my canonical documentation in `docs/`.

## Quick Start

```sh
./bin/l0c verify docs/examples/01_arithmetic_add_wrap.l0
./bin/l0c build docs/examples/01_arithmetic_add_wrap.l0 /tmp/l0_wiki_quick.img
./bin/l0c run /tmp/l0_wiki_quick.img 5 8
```
